Micropolis Showcases Physical AI at AIM Congress 2026

image.alt: Micropolis Robotics showcases its autonomous robots alongside Dubai Police at AIM Congress 2026 in Dubai

children: -- Micropolis Robotics (NYSE American: MCRP), a leading UAE-based developer of autonomous mobile robots and AI-enabled systems, is participating in the Annual Investment Meeting (AIM Congress 2026) in Dubai, using the global platform to advance its growth and present its locally developed autonomous technologies to international decision-makers.

During the three-day event at Dubai World Trade Centre, Micropolis is showcasing its autonomous robotic platforms alongside Dubai Police before an audience of senior government officials, investors, technology leaders and international delegations.

The showcase places Physical AI in a real-world context, demonstrating how intelligent machines that can perceive, navigate and act autonomously can support public safety, situational awareness, infrastructure protection, monitoring, inspection and complex field operations.

Beyond the technology showcase, Micropolis Robotics is engaging directly with prospective government and commercial customers, investors and technology partners to explore pilot programmes, deployment opportunities and strategic collaborations across security, infrastructure, energy, logistics and urban services.

Micropolis Robotics Physical develops its technologies through a vertically integrated model spanning mechatronics, embedded systems, artificial intelligence, autonomous driving, fleet intelligence and mission-planning software. This approach gives the company control across the development cycle and enables it to build purpose-designed robotic platforms around the requirements of complex operating environments.

The showcase alongside Dubai Police gives an international audience a closer look at the relevance of UAE-developed robotics to evolving public-safety and operational needs. It also highlights Dubai’s role as a global proving ground for emerging technologies and the UAE’s wider ambition to translate advanced engineering into commercially relevant capabilities.

Micropolis Robotics is a UAE-based company specializing in the design, development, and manufacturing of unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs’), AI systems, and smart infrastructure for urban, security, and industrial applications. The Company’s vertically integrated capabilities cover everything from mechatronics and embedded systems to AI software and high-level autonomy.
For more information, please visit www.micropolis.ai.
